function [waypoints_window, velocity_window, valid_flag, loiter_flag, distance_to_target] = WindowManager(position_in, velocity_in, window_length, uav_e, uav_n)

%#codegen
persistent position_buffer velocity_buffer buffer_counter loiter_flag_internal

if isempty(position_buffer)
    position_buffer = zeros(100000, 3);
    velocity_buffer = zeros(100000, 3);
    buffer_counter = 1;
    loiter_flag_internal = false;
end

waypoints_window = zeros(window_length, 3); % 只是保證型態固定
velocity_window = zeros(window_length, 3);
valid_flag = false;
loiter_flag = false;
distance_to_target = 0;
% position_buffer(buffer_counter,:) = position_in;
% velocity_buffer(buffer_counter,:) = velocity_in;

uav_speed = 15; % UAV速度固定20m/s

%==================OFF LINE====================%
if buffer_counter <= size(position_in, 1)
    % target_now = [0 0 0];
    % velocity_now = [0 0 0];
    target_now = position_in(buffer_counter, :);
    velocity_now = velocity_in(buffer_counter, :);

    if buffer_counter + window_length - 1 <= size(position_in, 1)
        waypoints_window = position_in(buffer_counter : buffer_counter + window_length - 1, :);
        velocity_window = velocity_in(buffer_counter : buffer_counter + window_length - 1, :); 
    
        distance_to_target = norm([uav_e - target_now(1), uav_n - target_now(2)]);
        target_speed_now = norm(velocity_now(1:2));
    
        if (target_speed_now < uav_speed) && (distance_to_target <= 30)
            loiter_flag_internal = true;
        elseif distance_to_target > 100
            loiter_flag_internal = false; 
        end

        loiter_flag = loiter_flag_internal;



        if buffer_counter == 1 || mod(buffer_counter, window_length) == 0
            valid_flag = true;
        end
    else
        valid_flag = false;
    end
    
else
    valid_flag = false;
    loiter_flag = true;
end

%=================ONLINE=======================%
% if mod(buffer_counter, window_length) == 0
% 
%     waypoints_window = position_buffer(buffer_counter-window_length+1 : buffer_counter, :);
%     velocity_window = velocity_buffer(buffer_counter-window_length+1 : buffer_counter, :);
% 
%     valid_flag = true; 
% end
% 
% target_speed_now = norm(velocity_in(1:2)); % 只看x、y方向速度
% distance_to_target = norm([uav_e - position_in(1), uav_n - position_in(2)]);
% 
% if (target_speed_now < uav_speed) && (distance_to_target < 50)
%     loiter_flag = true;
% else
%     loiter_flag = false;
% end

% end

% 累積新的資料
buffer_counter = buffer_counter + 1;
